papers.title_in_file: An Open Quantum System for Discrete Optimization - Quantum Computing Inc
papers.version_note: The text is not the paper. It is the navigation and footer shell of a Quantum Computing Inc resource-library web page: the page title, menu links, a support prompt, legal links and the Go Back, Download and Next page buttons. It holds no abstract, no body text and no results.
papers.not_read: The whole paper body. The saved text layer holds only the web page's menu and footer (778 characters, no page breaks); the article itself was not captured.
papers.what_it_is: A saved QCi resource-library web page whose text layer carries only site navigation and footer text, not the publication.
papers.why_not: The text holds no paper content, so it bears on no context. The page title is the only topical text, and it states no claim.
